name: Ca Mau
provinceNote: Since 1 July 2025, Cà Mau is the former Cà Mau and Bạc Liêu provinces together. Resolution 202/2025/QH15, clause 22, passed on 12 June 2025, prints 7,942.39 km² and 2,606,672 people and borders An Giang, Cần Thơ, and the East Sea. The clause does not name a capital.
dotReason: The southern cape, the marker and the two seas, is worth the road from Cần Thơ.
summary: You come for the last land: the ship-shaped panel or the GPS0001 marker, mangrove or mudflat still in the frame, and the water on both sides of the tip, where the East Sea and the West Sea meet. Sleep in the river wards of the city. Stay when that cape is the trip. Go to Cần Thơ when the river city is the trip, to Bến Tre when the coconut canals are the trip, and to Phú Quốc when the island beach is the trip.
timeNeeded: One night in the city, a road day south
fee: Cape gate figures disagree. Check on arrival.
getThere: Ca Mau airport (CAH), or the expressway from Can Tho. Clocks disagree.
seoTitle: Ca Mau city guide — the Dat Mui cape and the two seas
seoDescription: Stay in the city and ride south to Đất Mũi, where the East Sea and the West Sea meet. The Cần Thơ expressway is 110.85 km. The cape-gate hours disagree.
intro: You wake in the city and ride south. The picture at the end of the road is the ship-shaped panel, in place from the end of 2020, or the GPS0001 marker that closes đường Hồ Chí Minh, with mangrove or mudflat and the sea in the same view. The Ngọc Hiển page of 23 August 2024 prints the line “Tổ quốc tôi như một con tàu / Mũi thuyền ta đó Mũi Cà Mau” on that panel, the sail text “Mũi Cà Mau”, and the coordinates on it, 8°37'30" north and 104°43' east. Work on the road-end marker started on 15 February 2017, at an investment of about 70 billion đồng. The same page names the sea wall and Cột cờ Hà Nội, and it says you look at the place where the East Sea and the West Sea meet. UNESCO describes the tip as the place two tidal regimes meet and new mudflats form. The Ramsar news page prints a wetland point of 08°41'00"N 104°47'32"E. That is the sheet’s point for the site, not the coordinates on the marker, and not a city-center pin. Sleep in the river wards the city list prints as phường An Xuyên and phường Tân Thành, beside the older phường numbers. A night at ấp Mũi, xã Đất Mũi, is the other bed, and only when the dawn inside the gate is the point. The evening is the city river and the Gành Hào boats. A bar street was not on the office pages. A night walk at the marker was not on the management-board pages. Stay when the cape is the trip. Go to Cần Thơ when that river city is the trip.

The culture-office listing for the national park, which shares the Đất Mũi address, prints 15,000–30,000 VND and hours 07:00–18:00, and says time at one point is not limited. A tour page dated 30 September 2026 prints the gate at 06:30–17:30 every day including Tết, adult 30,000 VND, a child from 1 m to 1.3 m and students at 15,000 VND, and no ticket under 1 m or for a severe disability. The hours disagree. The price band matches, and the office page does not split adult and child. Keep both. An electric cart at 10,000–15,000 VND a person, and canoe trips at about 600,000–800,000 VND for a short ride or about 1,200,000–1,600,000 VND for a long ride, for a boat of 6–8 people, are only on that tour page. The office listing does not confirm them. Check on arrival. The same tour page prefers 08:00–10:00 and after 15:00, and says a departure from the city after 13:00 misses the gate. The office listing does not print that advice. The expressway ends at nút giao IC12, xã Hồ Thị Kỷ, and motorbikes are not allowed on it. The cape road is the one south of Năm Căn.

The mangrove behind the tip is Vườn quốc gia Mũi Cà Mau. Decision 142/2003/QĐ-TTg of 14 July 2003 upgraded it from the Đất Mũi nature reserve of Decision 194/CT on 9 August 1986. The conservation page prints an area over 41,800 hectares. The Ramsar sheet prints 41,862 hectares, about 13,400 hectares of mangrove and about 26,000 hectares of mudflat. The opened information sheet prints the designation date 13/12/12 and site number 2088. The Ramsar news page is dated 27 November 2012. The conservation page says the park was recognized as a Ramsar site in 2013. A search record of the sites page, which returned 404 on 22 October 2026, also showed 12 December 2013. Keep the dates. UNESCO names this park, U Minh Hạ, and the west-coast belt as cores of the 2009 biosphere reserve. U Minh Hạ is the other forest, north of the city at ấp Vồ Dơi, xã Đá Bạc: melaleuca on peat, a different gate from the cape, and a different park from U Minh Thượng. The park homepage prints no fee and no hour. One commercial page prints 10,000 VND and 07:30–17:00. Another prints about 30,000–50,000 VND. A third prints 07:20–17:00. Boat prices on those commercial pages are 150,000 VND a person an hour or 80,000 VND for 30 minutes. The homepage does not confirm them. Distance on those pages is about 40 km and about 1 hour, or about 35 km and about 50 minutes to 1 hour. A visit of half a day to two days is on commercial pages only. The homepage prints no stay. Check on arrival, and do not choose one fee or one clock.

In town, the morning is the river. UNESCO puts a floating market of hundreds of boats on the Gành Hào, in the center. The city handbook also names the market and prints no hour. Check on arrival. The Cần Thơ dawn is a different market. Chùa Monivongsa Bopharam is on đường Đinh Tiên Hoàng, phường 1, also printed as phường An Xuyên. Chùa bà Thiên Hậu is at số 77 Ngô Quyền, phường 9, also printed as phường An Xuyên. UNESCO names Quan Âm Cổ Tự, chùa Hưng Quang, and đền Tân Hưng separately. The provincial museum has two addresses on the pages opened: số 221 Ngô Quyền, phường 1, on the heritage directory, and số 1AB Lý Văn Lâm, phường 1, the working office since a provincial decision of 11 August 2021. The history-museum article says there is still no real museum building and that public displays are few. Hours were not printed. Check on arrival, and leave a museum block off the day. Nhà thờ Giáo xứ Cà Mau prints 68 Lê Lợi, phường 2, in the heading and 200/20 Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6, in the body. Keep both. Eat crab or salted ba khía with rice. The Ngọc Hiển page calls meat crab firm and sweet and roe crab full and rich. No restaurant street was named, and no stall price was printed.
gettingAround: Cảng hàng không Cà Mau, IATA CAH, is the airport. The Vietnam Airlines ticket page, opened 22 October 2026, prints it in phường 6, about 10 km from the center and 20–30 minutes in, with reference fares of 60,000 VND by xe ôm and 150,000 VND by taxi, to be agreed before the ride. The airline’s 2025 airport guide prints a different pair: số 93 đường Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6, and 2 km to the center, taxi 5–10 minutes and 70,000–100,000 VND, xe ôm 5–10 minutes and 20,000–40,000 VND. Keep both distances, both clocks, and both fares. VietnamPlus on 9 October 2026 quotes the airport director: commercial flights resume 29 November 2026 after more than a year stopped for an upgrade, Vietnam Airlines on an A321, Ho Chi Minh City to Cà Mau 12:50–13:55, return 14:50–15:50, fare 924,000–964,000 VND including the ticketing fee. The ticket page still lists Ho Chi Minh City–Cà Mau as the only direct route being flown, about 1 hour 10 minutes, one flight a day, with sample fares from 955,181 VND and a later line from 1,206,000 VND, and seats on dates that include 28 November 2026. The 2025 guide still says VASCO flies the only route once a day on an ATR-72 or ATR-42, outbound 11:25 for about 1 hour, return 12:45 for about 1 hour. These pages do not agree on whether a commercial flight is running, or on the block time. Check the airline before you count on a seat. Keep 1 hour, 1 hour 10 minutes, and the 12:50 departure as three clocks, not one. Connections via Tân Sơn Nhất on the ticket page are Hanoi about 4 hours 40 minutes to 7 hours 40 minutes, four flights a day, and Thanh Hóa about 4 hours 45 minutes, one flight a day. A Hanoi nonstop is a hope in the VietnamPlus piece, not a timetable. No ferry from this cape to Phú Quốc was on the pages opened.

There is no passenger station to take. Tuổi Trẻ on 10 October 2025 says the Mekong Delta has had no railway since the Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho line stopped in 1958. The pre-feasibility it describes runs 175.2 km from ga An Bình to ga Cần Thơ, through Ho Chi Minh City, Tây Ninh, Đồng Tháp, Vĩnh Long, and Cần Thơ, with twelve main stations, a hoped start at the end of 2027, and phase 1 basically finished in 2035. Cà Mau is not a station on that scheme. A later Cần Thơ–Cà Mau line is a hope in that article, not a decided alignment or a year. The usual previous stop is Cần Thơ, where the expressway ends. VietnamPlus and Tuổi Trẻ on 19 January 2026 print the length as 110.85 km. Pháp Luật / Tuổi Trẻ on 28 April 2026 prints nearly 111 km of main line and nearly 26 km of link roads. Keep both. The line opened for traffic at 11:00 on 19 January 2026. The Hậu Giang–Cà Mau section is 73.2 km. The Cần Thơ–Hậu Giang section had been open since 22 December 2025. Speed is 80 km/h maximum and 60 km/h minimum. Motorbikes, bicycles, and people on foot are not allowed. The project board says the expressway cuts the Cần Thơ–Cà Mau ride to 1.5 hours, from 3 hours before. The Tuổi Trẻ headline that day says about 90 minutes. One driver that morning told the paper the ride took more than 1 hour 15 minutes. Keep all three. The 3 hours is the old ride on the project board, not a measured Quốc lộ 1 timetable. The Hậu Giang–Cà Mau section was paused on 16 March 2026 for unfinished drains, slopes, and shoulders. The project board said the full line would reopen at 11:30 on 29 April 2026. A later closure, after that April notice, was not on the pages opened on 22 October 2026. The Cần Thơ end is at phường Cái Răng, off the Nam Sông Hậu / Quốc lộ 91B road, near Cảng Cái Cui. The Cà Mau end is IC12, xã Hồ Thị Kỷ, on the southern coastal corridor the notices call đường Hành lang ven biển phía Nam, or đường Xuyên Á. The expressway does not reach Đất Mũi. VietnamPlus says the line has non-stop toll gates and does not print a toll. Check on arrival for the đồng amount. A kilometer for Quốc lộ 1 from Cần Thơ to the city, and a road duration from Ho Chi Minh City, were not on the airport, expressway, or tourism pages opened. Check on arrival.

South of the city, Báo Đầu tư on 29 November 2023 prints 58.7 km of đường Hồ Chí Minh, from cầu Ông Tình at Năm Căn to Khu du lịch Đất Mũi, xã Đất Mũi, huyện Ngọc Hiển. That project starts at Năm Căn, not at the city. Phase 1 was finished in 2016. The alignment is drawn as cấp III đồng bằng, design speed 80 km/h, and the article says the cross-section still matches cấp V, about 40 km/h, on a sealed coat. Four bridges, Rạch Tàu, Rạch Vàm, Xóm Mũi, and Rạch Bầu Nhỏ, are printed at a 60 km/h design. An upgrade to a real cấp III road was proposed at about 4,204.1 billion đồng, with a hoped finish in 2027 if approved. That 2027 date is the hope in a 2023 article. A Vietravel page says the cape is more than 100 km from the city, and that mũi Bãi Bùng is 34 km southwest of thị trấn Năm Căn. A tour page prints 100–110 km and 2.5–3.5 hours by road, more than 50 km and more than 1 hour on Quốc lộ 1 to Năm Căn, plus more than 50 km on the Hồ Chí Minh road. Keep every figure. Do not add them into one official kilometer. A city-to-cape minute was not on the road-project page. The 2.5–3.5 hours is one tour page. Motorbikes can use this road. A canoe from Năm Căn is named on the tour page. No official canoe timetable or fare was opened. Check on arrival. An official coach bay with a street number was not opened. One commercial page prints Bến xe Cà Mau on đường Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6, phone 02903 811 063, about 9.3 km and about 15 minutes from the center, and local buses between the station and Năm Căn, Sông Đốc, Thới Bình, U Minh, Phước Long, and Ngã Năm, at 05:00–17:00 with a bus every 15 minutes. One source. Confirm the bay on arrival, and do not treat the 15 minutes as a provincial timetable. A 2026 public coach fare and a clock from Ho Chi Minh City or from Cần Thơ were not on that page. Check on arrival. Hòn Đá Bạc is about 50 km by water and 42 km by road on the national tourism extract, and about 50 km on the airline guide. Keep both road figures. Đầm Thị Tường is about 40 km on that same airline guide, one source. A city-center taxi fare that is not an airport ride was not printed. Check on arrival. A month when the expressway or the cape road closes was not on the pages opened. Check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: River wards
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in the city, in the river wards the city list prints as phường An Xuyên and phường Tân Thành, beside the older phường numbers. The usual night is here. No hotel brand is a pick.

stayAreas.name: Ấp Mũi
stayAreas.summary: A night at ấp Mũi, xã Đất Mũi, is for a dawn inside the gate. The culture-office listing closes the gate at 18:00. A tour page closes it at 17:30. The management board is at ấp Mũi. No hotel brand is a pick.

eat: Cua Cà Mau is the mangrove crab. The Ngọc Hiển page says meat crab is firm and sweet, and roe crab is full and rich. The airline page says the same pair. Order it steamed, rang me, or as lẩu cua. The area is Đất Mũi and the city. No restaurant is named, and no stall price is printed.

Ba khía muối Rạch Gốc is the small mangrove crab. The Ngọc Hiển page says it eats fallen mắm fruit, so the meat is firm and the roe is scant, and that the salted form is the famous one, eaten with hot rice. The same page also names hấp, rang me, and nướng. Người Lao Động on 29 December 2019 says the crabs gather around the tenth lunar month, which is why salting kept them, and that the salting trade of Ngọc Hiển was recognized with the honey-keeping trade as national intangible heritage. VOV names the same two trades. One later article describes pulling the shell and mixing with sugar, lime, garlic, chili, and rau răm. That mix is one article. The office page is the rice. The 2024 office address is khóm 8, thị trấn Rạch Gốc, huyện Ngọc Hiển. Later cape pages say xã Đất Mũi. Keep both. A stall price and a market hour were not printed. Check on arrival.

Cá thòi lòi is the mudskipper of the flats. The Ngọc Hiển page says it swims, runs on the water and the mud, and climbs, and that it is not bony and not strongly fishy. Order it grilled, in a hotpot, kho tiêu, or dried. Lẩu mắm U Minh, on that page and on the airline page, uses mắm cá sặc and chopped lemongrass, with fish, shrimp, squid, and the greens đọt nhãn lồng, rau đắng, càng cua, bông súng, and đọt choại. Cá lóc nướng U Minh, on the national tourism news page, is best from the tenth lunar month through the first lunar month. The local order on that page is nhất nướng, nhì nấu canh chua, tam kho, tứ luộc, grilled over straw or tram-wood charcoal, with rau cỏ the, bông súng, and đọt rau muống đồng. The next solar dates for that window are check on arrival. Nghêu Khai Long, on the cape board, has thick meat that is not sandy. The pot is lemongrass and crushed ginger under the clams, chili if wanted, until the shells open, with muối tiêu chanh or nước mắm chua ngọt, eaten hot. The flat is busiest after Tết through the end of May and June. Lẩu cá khoai, on the airline page, is a fish that is not bony, with crisp sweet flesh, herbs, and bún. Đuông chà là, on that page, is fat and white, taken from the palm trunk, eaten with nước mắm, and not for everyone. The page prints no further recipe. Bags to carry are dried shrimp and dried fish, Năm Căn shrimp crackers, chuối khô, dưa bồn bồn, mắm cá lóc Thới Bình, U Minh honey, and rượu trái giác. The spirit has no printed measure. A named restaurant street was not opened.
interestsBody: The cape is the reason to come: the marker or the ship panel, the mangrove, and the two seas in one view. GPS0001 is the southern land mark on the Ngọc Hiển page.
Rừng đước is the Ramsar mangrove at the tip. Rừng tràm U Minh Hạ is peat and melaleuca north of the city, the other core of the same 2009 biosphere. They are two forests and two gates.

Hòn Đá Bạc is the granite on the Gulf side. Khai Long is the clam flat, not a towered shore. Hòn Khoai sits offshore in the reserve. The city night is the river, and the gifts to carry are dried seafood, Năm Căn crackers, Thới Bình mắm, U Minh honey, and giác spirit. A mall and a shop photo were not on the pages opened.

interestCards.title: The cape and the two seas
interestCards.summary: The marker, the mudflat, and the water on both sides. Sleep in the city and ride south while the gate is open.

interestCards.title: Rừng đước
interestCards.summary: The mangrove at the tip, behind the same Đất Mũi address as the marker.

interestCards.title: Rừng tràm U Minh Hạ
interestCards.summary: Melaleuca on peat, north of the city. A different day from the cape.

interestCards.title: Biển Tây and the rock
interestCards.summary: Hòn Đá Bạc on the Gulf side. Official pages print no fee. Tour pages do.

interestGroups.title: The cape and the two seas
interestGroups.summary: For a traveler who came for the marker, the mudflat, and the two tides, and who sleeps in the city.
body: The Ngọc Hiển page of 23 August 2024 names the ship-shaped panel, in place from the end of 2020, the line on it, the sail text “Mũi Cà Mau”, and the coordinates printed on it: 8°37'30" north, 104°43' east. It also names mốc GPS0001, the end of đường Hồ Chí Minh, work started 15 February 2017 at about 70 billion đồng, the sea wall, and Cột cờ Hà Nội. UNESCO describes two tidal regimes and new mudflats. The panel’s point and the Ramsar sheet’s wetland point, 08°41'00"N 104°47'32"E, are different readings. Neither is published here as the city center.

Gate hours are 07:00–18:00 and 15,000–30,000 VND on the culture-office listing, and 06:30–17:30 with an adult and child split on a tour page dated 30 September 2026. Keep both. A licensed photo of the marker with mangrove and sea in one frame was not filed, so this guide has no sight card for the cluster. Đất Mũi is this place.

cards.title: Dat Mui marker
cards.summary: The ship panel or GPS0001, at ấp Mũi. Hours on the two pages are 07:00–18:00 and 06:30–17:30.

interestGroups.title: Rừng đước
interestGroups.summary: For a boat or a walk in the mangrove at the tip, on the same cape day as the marker.
body: The park was upgraded on 14 July 2003 and the reserve dates from 9 August 1986. Area figures are over 41,800 hectares on the conservation page and 41,862 hectares on the Ramsar sheet, with about 13,400 hectares of mangrove and about 26,000 hectares of mudflat. Designation dates in the dossier are 13/12/12 on the information sheet, 27 November 2012 on the news page, 2013 on the conservation page, and 12 December 2013 on a search record of a page that returned 404. Keep them. The visitor is here for đước, the mud, and the birds. A boat hour was not on the office listing. Check on arrival.

The office listing and the tour page are the same fee and hour pair as the marker, because they share the Đất Mũi address. A family boat is how you see the forest. A licensed photo of a boat under the canopy was not filed, so there is no sight card.

cards.title: Mui Ca Mau National Park
cards.summary: Mangrove and mudflat at xã Đất Mũi. The area and the Ramsar year are both printed above.

interestGroups.title: Rừng tràm U Minh Hạ
interestGroups.summary: For a day north of the city in the melaleuca, when the cape was yesterday.
body: The homepage prints ấp Vồ Dơi, xã Đá Bạc, director Trần Công Hoằng, phones 0290 3 910 020 and 0290 3 910 070, and email vqguminhha@gmail.com. It does not print a fee, an hour, or a tower height, so a 24 m tower on commercial pages is not settled. Entrance figures to keep are 10,000 VND with 07:30–17:00, about 30,000–50,000 VND, and hours 07:20–17:00. Boat prices on the commercial pages are 150,000 VND a person an hour or 80,000 VND for 30 minutes. Distances to keep are about 40 km and about 35 km. The homepage does not print the kilometer.

This is not U Minh Thượng. Honey from the melaleuca, taken by gác kèo ong, is the jar to carry. A harvest month was not on the official pages opened. Check on arrival. A licensed photo of the canal and the boat was not filed.

cards.title: U Minh Ha
cards.summary: The peat forest north of the city. The homepage prints no fee. Commercial pages disagree.

interestGroups.title: Biển Tây and the rock
interestGroups.summary: For the granite on the Gulf, on a day that is not a second lap of the marker.
body: The national tourism extract says xóm Kinh Hòn, xã Khánh Bình Tây, huyện Trần Văn Thời. The relic page says ấp Kênh Hòn, xã Đá Bạc. Keep both names. The extract says about 6.43 hectares and three rocks, Hòn Ông Ngộ, Hòn Đá Lẻ, and Hòn Đá Bạc, the highest about 50 m, and shapes it calls sân tiên, giếng tiên, bàn chân tiên, and bàn tay tiên. It also names Lăng Ông Nam Hải, a whale skeleton, and the 7 December 1971 fight over a 105 mm gun position. The relic page dates the national listing to Decision 2245/QĐ-BVHTTDL on 22 June 2009, under the name Hòn Đá Bạc – Trung tâm chỉ huy kế hoạch phản gián CM12, 9 September 1981–9 September 1984.

The official extracts print no fee. Two tour pages print 20,000 VND for an adult and 10,000 VND for a child. One tour page prints 07:00–19:00. Keep the silence and the tour figures. Distances are about 50 km by water and 42 km by road on the extract, and about 50 km on the airline guide. The road it describes goes toward U Minh Hạ, then Nông trường Minh Hà, Cơi Năm, and ấp Đá Bạc B, then one bridge onto the rock. A licensed photo of the rock, the sea, and the bridge was not filed.

cards.title: Hon Da Bac
cards.summary: Three rocks on the Gulf. Official pages print no tariff. Two tour pages print 20,000 and 10,000 VND.

interestGroups.title: Nghinh Ông Sông Đốc
interestGroups.summary: For the whale rite of the west port, or the fishing fleet on an ordinary day.
body: The ministry, writing on 14 March 2025, says the peak that year was 11–17 March, equated to 12–18 of the second lunar month, with the opening on the evening of 13 March at thị trấn Sông Đốc. Báo Cà Mau printed 14–16 of the second lunar month, 13–15 March 2025. Keep both 2025 windows. Báo Cà Mau on 2 April 2026 says the festival runs on the 14th and 15th of the second lunar month, and that the 2026 day was 2 April, the 15th, the 101st time, counting from a temple built in 1925. The provincial police page dates that rite to 2 April 2026. The next solar dates move. Check on arrival. The 2026 paper says xã Sông Đốc. The 2025 ministry piece says thị trấn Sông Đốc, huyện Trần Văn Thời.

Boats escort Ông from Lăng Ông Nam Hải to the fish port and then to sea. The ministry says more than 90 fishing boats registered in 2025. The rite was named national intangible heritage in 2021. No ticket was printed. Check on arrival. A half day outside the festival has no sourced length. The procession is not an ordinary day. A licensed photo of the fleet was not filed.

cards.title: Song Doc
cards.summary: The west-coast port. The 2026 rite fell on 2 April. The next solar date moves.

interestGroups.title: Khmer and Hoa temples
interestGroups.summary: For the two temples the city list places in the center, on a daytime walk.
body: Chùa Monivongsa Bopharam is on đường Đinh Tiên Hoàng, phường 1, also printed as phường An Xuyên. Chùa bà Thiên Hậu is at số 77 Ngô Quyền, phường 9, also printed as phường An Xuyên. UNESCO’s Quan Âm Cổ Tự, chùa Hưng Quang, and đền Tân Hưng are other names. Hours and fees were not printed. Check on arrival.

The same city list dates the Hòn Khoai rising to 13 December 1940, led by Phan Ngọc Hiển, at the town temple on Nguyễn Trãi, phường 9, also printed as phường An Xuyên. That gate is in town. The island is not behind it. Đình Thần Tân Đức, at ấp 8, xã An Xuyên, also printed as phường An Xuyên, carries a Tự Đức edict of 29 November 1852. Nhà thờ Giáo xứ prints both 68 Lê Lợi, phường 2, and 200/20 Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6. The museum’s two addresses, and the fact that a finished hall was not open on the pages read, sit in the same town. A licensed photo of a temple roof was not filed.

cards.title: Monivongsa Bopharam
cards.summary: The Khmer pagoda on Đinh Tiên Hoàng. An hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: The Gành Hào boats
interestGroups.summary: For the floating market UNESCO puts in this city, on the river you sleep beside.
body: UNESCO says the Gành Hào, in the center, with hundreds of boats and produce. The city handbook names the market and prints no hour. Check on arrival. A pier name was not printed. This is the local market on the page. The Cần Thơ dawn is a different river.

The evening walk is this bank. A last hour was not printed. A named bar street was not on the tourism-department pages. Bags from the airline list, dried seafood, Năm Căn shrimp crackers, Thới Bình mắm, U Minh honey, and giác spirit, are bought in town. A mall and a shop photo were not opened, so shopping stays in this text. A licensed photo of the loaded boats was not filed.

cards.title: Ca Mau floating market
cards.summary: Boats on the Gành Hào, in the center. The hour the boats gather was not printed.

interestGroups.title: Khai Long flat
interestGroups.summary: For the clam bed beside the mangrove, on the cape day, not a resort shore.
body: The cape management board says the flat is nearly 4 km long and about 230 hectares, sand mixed into the bottom, and that residents call it a clam bed. The busy harvest is after Tết through the end of May and June. The city handbook adds sunrise and sunset and does not print a length. Whether the cape-gate ticket covers the flat is not clear. Check on arrival. Minutes from the gate were not printed.

The board’s pot is nghêu hấp sả: lemongrass and crushed ginger under the clams, chili if wanted, until the shells open, with muối tiêu chanh or nước mắm chua ngọt, eaten hot. A licensed photo of the flat, the horizon, and the mangrove edge was not filed.

cards.title: Khai Long
cards.summary: A clam flat of nearly 4 km. The harvest the board prints is after Tết through May and June.

interestGroups.title: The offshore islet
interestGroups.summary: For Hòn Khoai, in the reserve, when a boat is actually running. Not an afternoon from the marker.
body: UNESCO names Hòn Khoai with Hòn Chuối, Hòn Đá Bạc, and Hòn Buông. The city handbook says the group is Hòn Khoai, Hòn Tượng, Hòn Sao, Hòn Đồi Mồi, and Hòn Đá Lẻ, and that Hòn Khoai is the largest, about 4 km², and the highest. A landing pier, a fee, and a boat hour were not on these pages. Check on arrival.
The 13 December 1940 rising, led by Phan Ngọc Hiển, is told at the town temple on Nguyễn Trãi, not on the island. A licensed photo of the island from the water was not filed.

cards.title: Hon Khoai
cards.summary: The largest islet in the group, about 4 km². The pier and the fare were not printed.

faqs.q: Where should I sleep in Ca Mau?
faqs.a: In the city, in the river wards printed as phường An Xuyên and phường Tân Thành. A night at ấp Mũi is for a dawn inside the gate. The culture-office listing closes that gate at 18:00, and a tour page closes it at 17:30. No hotel brand is a pick.

faqs.q: Is a flight into Ca Mau running, and which clock is it?
faqs.a: The pages disagree, so check the airline before you count on a seat. VietnamPlus on 9 October 2026 says commercial flights resume 29 November 2026, Ho Chi Minh City to Cà Mau 12:50–13:55 and the return 14:50–15:50, at 924,000–964,000 VND. The ticket page, opened 22 October 2026, still lists the direct flight as operating, about 1 hour 10 minutes, once a day, with fares from 955,181 VND and from 1,206,000 VND. The 2025 airport guide prints VASCO at 11:25 outbound and 12:45 back, about 1 hour.

faqs.q: How long is the expressway from Can Tho?
faqs.a: The project board says 1.5 hours, from 3 hours before. The Tuổi Trẻ headline on 19 January 2026 says about 90 minutes. One driver that morning said more than 1 hour 15 minutes. The length is 110.85 km on the 19 January pages, and nearly 111 km of main line plus nearly 26 km of links on the 28 April notice. The toll was not printed. Check on arrival. The expressway ends at xã Hồ Thị Kỷ and does not reach Đất Mũi.

faqs.q: What does the Đất Mũi gate cost, and when does it shut?
faqs.a: The culture-office listing prints 15,000–30,000 VND and 07:00–18:00. A tour page dated 30 September 2026 prints 06:30–17:30, adult 30,000 VND, and 15,000 VND for a child from 1 m to 1.3 m or a student. The hours disagree. The office page does not split adult and child. Cart and canoe prices on the tour page are check on arrival.

faqs.q: Is there one entrance fee for Hòn Đá Bạc and for U Minh Hạ?
faqs.a: No figure is chosen. The national tourism extract and the relic page print no Hòn Đá Bạc fee. Two tour pages print 20,000 VND for an adult and 10,000 VND for a child, and one tour page prints 07:00–19:00. The U Minh Hạ homepage prints no fee and no hour. Commercial pages print 10,000 VND and 07:30–17:00, about 30,000–50,000 VND, and 07:20–17:00. Check on arrival.

season.label: Clams after Tết
season.note: The cape board says Bãi Khai Long, nearly 4 km and about 230 hectares, is busiest for clams after Tết through the end of May and June. The gate is daytime: 07:00–18:00 on the culture-office listing, and 06:30–17:30 on the 30 September 2026 tour page. Nghinh Ông Sông Đốc moves. The ministry’s 2025 peak was 11–17 March, equated to 12–18 of the second lunar month, opening the evening of 13 March. Báo Cà Mau printed 14–16 of the second lunar month, 13–15 March 2025. In 2026 the paper and the provincial police page put the 15th of the second lunar month on 2 April, the 101st time. The next solar dates move. Check on arrival. Dân trí, citing the 2026 provincial plan, places Nghinh Ông Gành Hào and Hương rừng U Minh inside 25–30 April 2026, and Festival tôm in November 2026 without the days. The Lạc Long Quân rite at xã Đất Mũi has no civil dates on the cape board homepage. A month when the road closes was not printed.
